title: Carry a recorded reconcile exception forward instead of failing on it every day (#2344)
body:
Net: the daily campaign-money job no longer blocks every day on the 6 committee-years a person already waived on 23 Sep. A committee-year whose reconciliation failure is already recorded on the live release (its split already withheld) is carried forward as a known disagreement; only a NEW committee-year fails and needs its own named waiver. The scheduled run still invents no exception.

Why: the first scheduled-style run of `scripts/refresh_campaign_finance.py --target production` (24 Sep 2026, 10:44 to 12:32 UTC) published the totals with no waiver and then quarantined all 3 payment files, because `contributions/reported_totals_reconcile` failed on exactly the 6 committee-years waived the night before (30277/2022, 30343/2022, 40889/2022, 41229/2022, 41243/2022, 41248/2023). Without this rule it would do so every day until the Board's own figures moved. Recorded on [issue 2344](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/issues/2344).

What changed:
- `alethical/pipeline/campaign_finance.py`: `_carried_reconcile_filer_years(baseline)` reads the published snapshot's recorded `reported_totals_reconcile` committee-years. In `_checks_against_the_board`, a failed reconcile whose every committee-year is already recorded becomes `reported` (non-blocking) and keeps recording all of them, so the reader's `withheld_filer_years_from_checks` still withholds the split; a failure with any new committee-year stays `failed` and names only the new ones as needing a waiver; a waiver records the new AND the carried pairs so the next release inherits all of them.
- Test `test_a_reconcile_committee_year_waived_on_the_published_release_is_carried_not_failed` covers all 3 branches (carried and published; new pair blocks naming only itself; waiving the new one records both).
- `docs/architecture/campaign-finance-system-design.md` §4.3 states the rule in 1 sentence.

Docs check: reread campaign-finance-system-design.md §4.3 (comparison checks and named exceptions) and data-ingestion-onboarding.md §H (the daily job never waives anything, still true: it inherits a recorded exception by exact committee-year); §4.3 gained the carry-forward sentence, §H needed no change.
Stale-reference check: nothing affected.

title: Carry a waived reconcile committee-year only while both compared figures are unchanged (#2344)
body:
Net: a waived reconcile disagreement is now carried forward only while the 2 figures the person ruled on are unchanged to the cent. If our itemized total or the filer's reported figure moves under the same committee-year, the daily job treats it as a new disagreement and blocks for its own named waiver, printing the old and new figures side by side. Codex's 1 concern on [pull request 2358](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/pull/2358), relayed by the coordinating session on [issue 2344](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/issues/2344).

What changed:
- `Check.figures` (`alethical/pipeline/campaign_finance.py`): `reported_totals_reconcile` records, per failing committee-year, `{"ours": "46126.81", "reported": "6753.43"}`, and every status that carries committee-years (`failed`, `reported`, `overridden`) records them too.
- `_carried_reconcile_filer_years` now returns each recorded committee-year with its figures; the carry rule keeps a pair only when the published release recorded figures for it and they equal today's. A pair recorded without figures is treated as new. A waived publish records the new and the still-carried pairs with today's figures; a pair that reconciled is no longer carried on.
- Test `test_a_reconcile_committee_year_waived_on_the_published_release_is_carried_not_failed` gains 3 branches: figures recorded on the carried publish; the filer's figure moving blocks and names both figure pairs; a release recorded without figures blocks.
- `docs/architecture/campaign-finance-system-design.md` §4.3: the waiver is a ruling on 2 figures, not on a committee-year.

Transition: the live release `d5ab9f03` recorded its 6 carried committee-years without figures, so the first comparison after this merges would block on them. Their figures are recorded once, by hand, on the live snapshot's check record before tomorrow's run, with the values read from a dry run of this code against the live release, and that write is noted on issue 2344.

Docs check: reread campaign-finance-system-design.md §4.3 (comparison checks and named exceptions) and data-ingestion-onboarding.md §H (the daily job never waives anything, still true); §4.3 gained the 2-figure sentence, §H needed no change.
Stale-reference check: nothing affected.

title: Preserve browser-filled addresses and working search results
body:
Net: Saved browser addresses accept common US country suffixes, and late downloads no longer erase a working search.

## What

Browser autofill can update the visible address before the application receives a change event. An unrelated render could then replace that address with old text. Candidate and legislator forms now retain the browser value, read it at submission, and still apply deliberate selections and resets. A shared formatter accepts a recognized terminal US country name and common punctuation after a complete street/state/ZIP address without weakening house, unit or ambiguity matching.

Automatic release recovery is limited to startup before a screen draws. Required-screen, optional-section and abandoned downloads now recover according to their purpose. Later failures retain the navigator, results and unsent forms; failed sign-in downloads offer visible Reload and Close actions. Candidate addresses stay in temporary memory. Legislator lookup retains its existing Census-first lookup and address-in-link behavior.

The candidate header now stays above its following content, so Search/About rows receive clicks. Their shared invisible pointer bridge preserves the existing 26px visual gap while allowing slow diagonal movement in either direction.

## Linked issue

Closes https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/issues/2473

## How I verified it

- Full upload checks passed: 4,071 backend tests and 4,055 frontend tests, plus type/format/build-tool security checks on the final commit. Static-style extraction has 14 focused regression checks.
- 36 release-browser checks passed, 12 each in Chromium, WebKit and Firefox: silent browser fill, Enter/button/blur submission, correction after failure, 30-second stability after a late download failure, Back from a failed candidate profile download, retained Contact text, sign-in failure/Close, and startup recovery capped at 1 reload.
- Menu regression passes in Chromium and WebKit: 8 desktop journeys per browser and touch checks at 820, 390 and 320 pixels, including continuous slow pointer paths in both directions, full-row hit areas, keyboard selection/Escape, election selection and outside dismissal.
- Independent Chromium/WebKit review covered phone/tablet/computer widths, short screens, focus entry and return, Escape, hover and touch. The final 6px scroll-padding correction passes at 320×300.
- Release assets, CSP, icon checks and first-load budget pass (297,083 of 297,506 compressed bytes locally). Fixed metadata and unchanged focus/autofill CSS now arrive directly in HTML, avoiding runtime-injector download overhead. Hosted production must pass its own measurement.
- The public civic address 12805 St Croix Trl S, Hastings, MN 55033 resolved against official sources identically with no country and with United States, U.S.A., parentheses or a dash separator.
- Physical iPhone/Android keyboard autocomplete is not exercised by browser-value simulation. The exact historical phone reset trigger was not captured; tests establish the repaired reload paths, not that historical cause.

Docs check: Updated [find-my-candidates-guide.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/product-onboarding/find-my-candidates-guide.md), [find-my-legislator-guide.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/product-onboarding/find-my-legislator-guide.md), [page-load-performance-decisions.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/operations/page-load-performance-decisions.md), [design-principles.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/design/design-principles.md), and [workflow.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/.claude/rules/workflow.md). The [candidate-autofill-recovery-plan.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/implementation/candidate-autofill-recovery-plan.md) records affected uses, meaningful differences, prevention and remaining uncertainty. Shared personal prevention instructions shipped separately in [tool-settings pull request 48](https://github.com/euglopi/tool-settings/pull/48).

title: Keep candidate address editing and first-click search stable
body:
Net: Changing an address stays open while typing, and Search responds to the first click or tap with suggestions visible.

## What

Final live review of [pull request 2474](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/pull/2474) found 2 additional candidate-form transitions. Typing the exact previous request closed the edit form without submission. Editing now ends only when a successful replacement arrives, including an explicitly submitted cached result.

On phones, clicking Search blurred the field and removed the inline suggestion before pointer release, moving the button 128px away from the pointer. The submit button now uses the existing suggestion-choice keep-focus behavior during pointer activation. Keyboard focus and the approved layout are preserved.

## Linked issue

Closes https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/issues/2473

## How I verified it

- The address-edit regression failed before repair and passes afterward; 39 focused flow/form tests pass, including failures, old requests and profile navigation.
- The first-click browser regression failed before repair; first mouse click and emulated touch tap pass in Chromium and WebKit at the original preview address.
- Type checking and release export pass. All 15 release-browser journeys pass in Chromium and WebKit; the 3 added edit/click/tap checks pass in Firefox. Independent actual-source acceptance passes mouse, touch emulation and Tab then Enter at the original preview.
- Full upload checks pass: 4,071 backend and 4,056 frontend tests. The final committed browser check waits for editing to finish, rather than mistaking deliberately retained old results for completion.
- Physical iPhone/Android keyboard autofill remains untested; browser touch and saved-value simulation do not establish that coverage.

Docs check: Updated [find-my-candidates-guide.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/product-onboarding/find-my-candidates-guide.md) and [candidate-autofill-recovery-plan.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/implementation/candidate-autofill-recovery-plan.md) with causes, shared-use differences and prevention checks.

title: Show candidate address search progress inside its button
body:
Net: Address searches on `/candidates` show “Finding candidates…” inside their steady search button.

The entry and Change address buttons now replace their ready label with the approved waiting text and spinner. Initial and Change address retries use that button and its hidden announcement as the sole waiting-message owner; election retries without the form retain their existing update notice. Explicit address submission owns focus, so other request triggers cannot move focus to the address button. Remove the repeated visible waiting line, keep its error space, retain explicit submit focus and 1 hidden polite announcement, and block repeat clicks or Enter. Try again retains its existing disabled waiting behavior; it does not promise focus retention. Preserve existing address-fill handling, results, election status and sibling buttons. An address-only update no longer inserts a repeated election line that moved old desktop results41px; retain that line whenever the requested election differs.

Implements the isolated approved `Alethical UX (55).zip` update. The ready-state drawing's waiting label conflicts with its explicit rest/restore instructions; preserve the settled ready label “Find my candidates”. The tablet waiting text wraps inside the approved fixed-height button.

Validation: final upload checks4071 backend/4057 frontend tests plus required formatting/dependency/security checks;69 focused candidate tests; TypeScript; production export and first-load budget (297085/297506 bytes); Chromium and WebKit at 1280/900/390 for slow success, error/retry, fixed geometry/fill, repeat activation, focus, reduced motion and unchanged election updates; first touch with a visible suggestion and repeat touch in both browsers. Independent review passes final submit/election/retry keyboard focus and recovery. Physical phone keyboard/autofill and spoken screen-reader output remain untested.

Docs check: read [find-my-candidates-guide.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/product-onboarding/find-my-candidates-guide.md) and [candidate-design-release-acceptance.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/implementation/candidate-design-release-acceptance.md); updated the waiting behavior, comparison record, shared impact and completion checks. [candidate-lookup-build-plan.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/implementation/candidate-lookup-build-plan.md) and [candidate-autofill-recovery-plan.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/implementation/candidate-autofill-recovery-plan.md) remain accurate.
Stale-reference check: replaced the unchanged-label requirement in [candidate-design-release-acceptance.md](https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/blob/main/docs/implementation/candidate-design-release-acceptance.md); election status and unrelated form requirements remain accurate.

Closes https://github.com/alethical-org/alethical/issues/2478

Parent acceptance and original preview integration pass at http://localhost:19047/candidates. A read-only public-address lookup through the real API succeeds: entry busy248×60; Change address busy360×52 and retained State offices heading y206→206. The candidate lookup task owns current-head CI, merge and live verification.
